about: The record of Where Parks Stand: a dozen minutes of four park committees. Every park, committee, decision and address here is invented.

minutes.title: Dogs in the park
passages: The Committee agreed that dogs must be kept on leads in the walled garden from 1 April 2026.
Members noted that dogs may run free on the main field as before.

minutes.title: Opening hours
passages: The Committee agreed that the gates would open at 7am and close at dusk throughout the summer.
A proposal to leave the gates open overnight was not supported.

minutes.title: Playground
passages: The Committee approved £18,000 for new play equipment, to be met from the improvement fund.
The work is expected to be finished by March 2027.

minutes.title: Dogs on the common
passages: The Committee resolved to make no change to the rules on dogs, which may be off the lead across the common.
Members asked for more bins for dog waste at the north entrance.

minutes.title: Summer events
passages: The Committee agreed to allow three evening concerts in July, each ending by 9.30pm.
Residents of Mill Lane had written to object to the noise.

minutes.title: Tree planting
passages: The Committee agreed to plant 40 native trees along the eastern boundary this winter.
The cost, £2,400, will be met by a grant from the county's tree fund.

minutes.title: Café lease
passages: The Committee agreed to renew the café's lease for five years at a rent of £9,500 a year.
The tenant will keep the public toilets open during the café's hours.

minutes.title: Dogs and the towpath
passages: The Committee agreed that dogs must be on leads along the towpath, where cyclists and walkers share a narrow path.
The rule will be reviewed after twelve months.

minutes.title: Opening hours
passages: The Committee agreed to keep the gardens open until 10pm from June to August.
The gates will be locked at 8pm for the rest of the year.

minutes.title: Cycling
passages: The Committee agreed to allow cycling on the perimeter path at walking pace.
Cycling across the bowling green and the flower beds remains forbidden.

minutes.title: Toilets
passages: The Committee heard that the toilet block had been closed since April because of vandalism.
Members agreed to seek quotes for repairs and to report back in September.

minutes.title: Budget
passages: The Committee noted an underspend of £3,100 on grounds maintenance.
Members agreed to carry the sum forward to pay for repairs to the toilet block.
